name: Castel Guelfo di Bologna (Italy)
description: White field charged at the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Castel Guelfo di Bologna (a white bend and fleurs-de-lis on red) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CASTEL GUELFO DI BOLOGNA in black at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Castel Guelfo di Bologna, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castel Guelfo di Bologna arms — white bend and fleurs-de-lis on red, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CASTEL GUELFO DI BOLOGNA
